macros.name: getintercharclass
macros.doc: \getintercharclass[⟨scheme⟩]{⟨char-code⟩}{\cs} gets the class number of the specified character in the specified scheme, and stores the result in \cs.

macros.name: getintercharstate
macros.doc: \getintercharstate[⟨scheme⟩]{\cs} gets current state of the specified scheme and store the state code in \cs.

macros.name: getinterchartoks
macros.doc: \getinterchartoks[⟨scheme⟩]{⟨char-class-1⟩}{⟨char-class-2⟩}{\cs} gets the tokens to be inserted between ⟨char-class-1⟩ and ⟨char-class-2⟩ in the specified scheme, and stores the result in \cs.

macros.name: intercharclass
macros.doc: \intercharclass[⟨scheme⟩]{⟨char-range⟩}{⟨char-class⟩} moves all characters within ⟨char-range⟩ to the class ⟨char-class⟩ in the specified scheme.

macros.name: interchartoks
macros.doc: \interchartoks[⟨scheme⟩]{⟨char-class-1⟩}{⟨char-class-2⟩}{⟨tokens⟩} defines tokens to be inserted between ⟨char-class-1⟩ and ⟨char-class-2⟩ (in that order) in the specified scheme.

macros.name: newintercharclass
macros.doc: \newintercharclass[⟨scheme⟩]{\cs} creates a new char class in the specified scheme and stores the class number in \cs.

macros.name: newintercharscheme
macros.doc: \newintercharscheme{⟨scheme⟩} creates a new char class scheme.
